description: Retrieve the BTS Transportation Services Index (TSI), a monthly economic indicator measuring the volume of freight and passenger transportation services across all modes. Returns total TSI, freight TSI, passenger TSI, plus component indices (vehicle miles traveled, rail carloads, transit, petroleum/gas pipelines). Base year 2000=100. Data from 2000 to present. Source: BTS TSI dataset (Socrata bw6n-ddqk). No auth — US Gov public domain.

end_date.description: End of date range in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2024-12-31").

limit.description: Maximum number of monthly records to return (1–300, default 12).

start_date.description: Start of date range in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2024-01-01"). Index goes back to 2000.

name: bts.transport.tsi

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: BTS — Transportation Services Index
